intent: Configure the columns in my personal and global Computer views.
actions: As a GLPI Super-Admin, open the Computer display-preference modal on Personal View with Status selected, Comments absent from both saved lists, and Global View not yet loaded.
Open the personal add-option dropdown, search for Comments, select the ordinary Comments field, and click Add; wait for the addition to finish.
Switch to Global View in the same modal and wait for its form to load.
Open the global add-option dropdown and search for Comments while both view forms remain loaded.
